name: Atlassian

P3 / P4 Senior.dsaDepth: Heavy - a bank of publicly-discoverable coding questions, own choice of language/IDE, plus system design and two "values" interviews
rounds: Technical phone screen (~1 hr, sometimes run by an external vendor like Karat)

Onsite/virtual loop (centralized - team matching happens AFTER the loop): 2 coding rounds (candidate’s own language and IDE), 1 system design round, 2 "soft-skills"/values interviews ("tell me about a time...")
extraTopics: Atlassian’s well-known "values" interviews - candidates report these can outweigh technical performance in the final decision
A full performance review only happens after every round is complete, so early strong feedback is not a reliable signal
P3 / P4 Senior.notes: Some loops add a distinct LLD-then-HLD-then-behavioral-then-manager sequence instead - composition varies by team/region.
